//: Binds each model NAME used in pipeline.scm to an OpenAI-compatible endpoint. The name string is sent verbatim as the wire model id, so it must be exactly what the endpoint expects. Secrets use env: indirection so this file stays commit-safe — export the vars in your shell before running.

models.//qwen: structurer — served by local LM Studio (the default above), no override needed.
models.//openrouter: roleplay + the three ideation-pool models all live on OpenRouter, sharing one endpoint+key (backends are memoized by baseURL+apiKey, so this is one client).
models.//opus: markets expert — Opus via Anthropic's OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
